steps.title: Tool conversion
steps.note: convertMcpTool takes an MCP tool definition and wraps it as an AI SDK dynamicTool. The input schema is forced to type object with additionalProperties: false so the model cannot pass extra keys.

steps.title: Transport creation
steps.note: Remote MCP servers try StreamableHTTP first, then SSE. OAuth is enabled by default unless explicitly disabled. The first successful transport becomes the active connection.

steps.title: Tool catalog and collisions
steps.note: toolCatalog lists tools from every connected MCP client, builds qualified names like allternit-tools.file.read, and resolves collisions by appending a deterministic suffix.
